$comment: Answer key for H6, the critic catch rate. The critic must never read this file,
and nothing under tests/fixtures/critic/ points at it.
Every defect listed here is invisible to the harness: all four fixtures pass
in light and dark. tests/meta/critic-fixtures.test.mjs re-proves that, because a
defect a gate can catch measures the gate rather than the critic.
`signals` are alternative phrasings, not the only correct wording. The score they
produce is a FLOOR: read the printed excerpts before quoting it.

defects.defect: Four equal-weight stat cards. Nothing leads, so the eye lands nowhere and the screen reads as generated.
The page stops after the card row. No footer, summary line or closing panel, so it reads as content that failed to load rather than content that finished.
Intro copy is a hollow triad ("Powerful, intuitive, and beautiful") plus marketing filler ("unlock", "seamless"). It says nothing a user can act on.
defects.rule: AGENTS.md -> Break these deliberately (hollow triads, marketing filler)

defects.defect: The empty state is a small centred block pinned under the header with the rest of the viewport blank. It does not own the space it is in.
defects.rule: .claude/rules/components.md -> Composition 3 (An empty state owns the viewport)

defects.defect: "No data. There is nothing to show." gives no first action, no explanation of what will appear here, and no way forward.
defects.rule: content/voice-tone.md -> Empty states (explain the value, guide to the first action)
signals: (no data|nothing to show).{0,100}(no (action|way|next|guidance|cta)|does ?n[o']t (say|tell|offer)|unhelpful|gives the user nothing)
(no (action|way|next|guidance|cta)|does ?n[o']t (say|tell|offer)|unhelpful|gives the user nothing).{0,100}(no data|nothing to show)

defects.defect: "SECTION 01" is a fake eyebrow label. It names nothing and exists only as decoration.
signals: (section 01|eyebrow).{0,100}(fake|decorat|means nothing|names nothing|arbitrary|no purpose|says nothing|numbered for no)
(fake|decorat|means nothing|names nothing|arbitrary|no purpose|says nothing|numbered for no).{0,100}(section 01|eyebrow)

defects.defect: Twenty-four rows that are identical apart from the number: same customer, same status, same amount. Nothing varies, so the eye has nowhere to land while scrolling.
defects.rule: .claude/rules/components.md -> Composition 5 (A long list needs one differentiator)

defects.defect: The table scrolls sideways inside its own region, and the only indication is an aria-label. Sighted users simply lose the last columns.
defects.rule: .claude/rules/components.md -> Composition 7 (A hidden overflow needs a visible cue)

defects.defect: A "Debug mode" checkbox is rendered in the product screen. It is scaffolding, not product.
The one piece of display type on the page says "Welcome". It is the right size and carries no information, so the largest element on the screen is wasted.
defects.rule: .claude/rules/components.md -> Composition 1, and AGENTS.md taste block (display type is short AND says something)
signals: (\"?welcome\"?|the h1|largest (element|type)).{0,100}(generic|says nothing|no information|wasted|tells (the user )?nothing|empty|could be any)
(generic|says nothing|no information|wasted|tells (the user )?nothing|empty|could be any).{0,100}(\"?welcome\"?|the h1|largest (element|type))

defects.defect: The in-flight state dims the button to the same opacity the disabled state uses, so "this is happening" reads as "you cannot do this".
The toast says "Draft project created" while the list above still shows the same two projects. The user catches the lie immediately.
defects.rule: .claude/rules/components.md -> Composition 6 (Feedback may not outrun the truth)

defects.defect: "Create draft project" and "Export" both wear the primary fill. Primary is the one main affirmative action; a secondary action must be neutral, never a coloured fill.
defects.rule: CLAUDE.md -> Non-negotiable 1 (Token by intent: one action role, one variant)

defects.defect: Three plan tiles of identical weight with no recommended option. The pricing choice is handed back to the user with no guidance.
defects.rule: .claude/rules/components.md -> Composition 1, and AGENTS.md (three identical equal-weight cards)
